observations.behavior: Adds a new action reportDashboardFilterChange and its implementation, including a PendingFilterChange record and dashboardSettingsMatch helper, and updates several filter-setting actions to use the new action instead of the old eventUsageLogic call.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a dedicated action to report dashboard filter changes, replacing a generic eventUsage call, and establishes a PendingFilterChange record to track the change and remaining insights.

observations.behavior: Adds a PendingFilterChange interface and a dashboardSettingsMatch helper, and uses them to track whether a refresh is still associated with an active filter change.
observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the current refresh is still associated with an active filter change, and adds the insight to the remainingInsightIds set if it is.

observations.behavior: Adds a new property filter_change_id and filter_change_duration_ms to the dashboard refresh event, and an all_insights_succeeded flag, and clears the pending filter change if all insights succeeded.
observations.posthog_connection: Records the filter change ID and duration, and checks whether all insights succeeded, and clears the pending filter change if they did.
